test_cases.name: official_register_first
test_cases.input: Add homemade Finnish company directories on top of YTJ. Keep search criteria.
assertions: Official YTJ remains first; homemade hits hydrate via official id before the criteria gate
Must-clauses are not relaxed to grow hit count
Unknown industry is rejected when industry is required
Does not invent companies, Y-tunnus, or revenue

test_cases.name: empty_result_diagnosis
assertions: UI or API distinguishes NO_MATCH, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, FILTER_EXCLUDED_ALL, PARTIAL, OUT_OF_COVERAGE
Diagnosis code survives the source-report sanitizer and is returned on the search run
Does not claim zero means the product is broken if the register honestly returned none
Does not fill empty fields with typical industry defaults
Does not show only generic 'no companies stored' when a reason code exists

test_cases.name: no_parallel_stack
test_cases.input: Herätä hive mind ja rakenna superjärjestelmä
assertions: Implements inside the existing app modules
Does not create a second repo, microservice-per-engine, or unused engine classes marked VERIFIED
Uses hive-system layer names when that skill is present

test_cases.name: css_not_rebuild
test_cases.input: Fix the padding on the login button
assertions: Does not activate a full intelligence rebuild
Leaves source registry and engines unchanged

test_cases.name: blocked_secret
assertions: Marks the licensed API BLOCKED without credentials
Does not scrape login-walled ratings or invent scores
May keep public HTML identity fields if already allowed, hydrating via official register
